other_conditions: The deceased worker must have been working at an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and must have had regular contributions to the labour welfare fund received by the board.
The deceased worker must have been a member of the Board for at least the last six months before death.
Any legal heir may apply for the benefit, provided they apply within three months from the date of death.
The applicant must produce a death certificate issued by the competent authority.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5000 will be given to the legal heirs of a deceased registered worker.
documents_required: Death certificate issued by the competent authority
